# `aitbc simulate wallets`

Simulate wallet creation and transactions with configurable balance.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc simulate wallets [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--wallets` | integer | `5` | no | Number of wallets to simulate |
| `--balance` | float | `1000.0` | no | Initial balance for each wallet |
| `--transactions` | integer | `20` | no | Number of transactions to simulate |
| `--amount-range` | text | `1.0-100.0` | no | Transaction amount range (min-max) |
| `--seed` | integer | — | no | Seed for deterministic simulation (default: live) |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc simulate wallets
```
